data.title: Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
data.description:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.

Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Position Summary

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.

What you'll own

Onboarding projects

  • Build and own the project plan for each new laboratory, from kickoff to go-live, with dependencies and dates kept current.

  • Direct the work across our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and the customer's staff.

  • Accompany the validations customers run as part of onboarding. The laboratory's medical director designs the study; you make sure the technical setup is correctly installed and working, that our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and that the customer has everything they need to complete it.

  • Carry the committed go-live date, and raise risks early with options rather than after a slip.

Customer success after go-live

  • Act as the customer's main point of contact once live, monitoring usage and engagement and reaching out proactively.

  • Own incoming support requests: resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop with the customer.

  • Bring what you learn from customers into product planning, and flag potential expansion opportunities to Sales where relevant.Bring what you learn from customers into product planning.

  • You do not carry a sales target. But flagging expansion opportunities to Sales is part of your responsibility.

How you'll start

You will take on real customer onboarding projects from the start and lead them yourself, with close support from the team and from your manager in the beginning. As you build familiarity with our products and our customers, you move into running them independently.

Your Profile

  • A degree in biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, medicine, or a related field.

  • 3+ years leading projects with external customers — clinical or diagnostic implementation, digital pathology, medical device or laboratory rollout, health IT deployment, or comparable delivery work.

  • Proven ability to build a realistic project plan and drive it to a date, updating it responsibly and transparently as things change.

  • Proven ability to direct people inside and outside the company.

  • Technically confident: able to discuss interfaces, integrations and data credibly with ML engineers and IT staff, instruct them clearly, and translate between them and the customer.

  • Able to hold a room with a laboratory director, a pathologist and an IT lead, and keep all three aligned.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. German is not required.

  • Based in Hamburg, or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.

  • Willing to travel to customer sites internationally — occasional trips, typically a few times a year, focus on US customers.

  • Comfortable with the occasional late-afternoon or early-evening call to overlap with customers in other time zones.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments, or a background in the natural sciences.

  • If you have not worked in pathology: evidence that you have become competent in an unfamiliar technical domain before.

  • Experience working within a quality management system, or delivering software into a regulated clinical setting.

  • Commercial instinct.

Why Mindpeak

  • Our vision is personalized, effective cancer treatment for every patient.

  • Build foundational AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development, and actively shape the future of personalized medicine.

  • An open, creative environment with flat hierarchies and fast decisions.

  • A leadership team that invests in continuous development.

  • A centrally located Hamburg office with a spectacular view over the harbor.

 

Application Details

Please send us your CV, job references, your salary expectations, and your earliest possible starting date.

Contact: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent German & English is a prerequisite for this role

data.title: Senior Program Manager, Onboarding (m/w/d)
data.description:
Why we need you

Maltego is a tool used globally by industry experts, analysts, and law enforcement agencies to help protect and watch over their own infrastructure but also to keep guard on internet safety, reduce crime and catch bad guys.
 
The Program Manager, Onboarding owns both delivery and governance within Maltego's customer onboarding program. You manage a portfolio of complex accounts from Sales handover to Customer Success handover, and simultaneously govern the playbooks, SOPs, and continuous improvement initiatives that allow the full onboarding team to deliver quality at scale. This role combines hands-on customer engagement with program-level leadership — you run accounts, and you design the systems others work within.


What to expect

Onboarding Delivery

  • Manage a portfolio of complex, high-touch, and scale-touch accounts end-to-end, balancing delivery responsibilities with program governance work.
  • Design and execute onboarding plans for accounts with advanced technical or organizational requirements.
  • Deliver Customer Success handovers that consistently meet or exceed acceptance criteria, maintaining high CSAT across your portfolio.
  • Use insights from account work to identify patterns and inform program improvement.
Program Management
  • Design the playbooks and SOPs for Scale-touch and High-touch onboarding, maintaining accuracy and ensuring they reflect current best practice.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, and driving rollout across the team.
  • Coordinate with Scaled and Digital Onboarding Managers to ensure program consistency across all onboarding formats.
  • Manage content accuracy as a program responsibility, working with Product to keep onboarding resources current after releases.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Build credibility with stakeholders through consistent delivery and clear communication.
  • Represent the program perspective in cross-functional meetings, contributing structured analysis and concrete recommendations.
  • Surface patterns from onboarding delivery into cross-team discussions, ensuring program feedback reaches the right people.

data.title: Safety, Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
data.description:
Who we are

Europe’s chemical industry faces an existential crisis resulting from a deep dependence on volatile fossil feedstocks, regulatory pressures, and cut-throat competition from China and the Middle East. Locally abundant bio-based feedstocks offer an escape route from fossil feedstock dependency, but chemical companies lack the technologies to bring them online.

At Level Nine, we’re building an AI-driven catalyst discovery platform to produce key chemical building blocks from locally abundant bio-based feedstocks, reducing dependence on volatile global feedstock markets while using existing chemical manufacturing infrastructure.

About the team & role

We are an interdisciplinary team of scientists and operators, supported by leading advisors, networks, and VCs across Europe. We’re based in Berlin, one of Europe’s leading deep-tech hubs. We are not looking for corporate specialists who need a finished process and mature documentation. We need high-agency analytical builders who are curious, reliable, and technically grounded, creating structure while the process is still evolving.

As we transition towards executing our industrial demo plant, we are navigating developing a chemical process that requires robust process safety, structured discipline, precise control loops, and ATEX compliance. You will serve as our internal owner and technical challenger for process safety concepts, control philosophies, instrumentation specifications, and automation architectures.

You will join our core engineering team to take on real, hands-on engineering work with direct impact. You will establish the control logic, P&IDs, instrument lists, and cause-and-effect interlocks for our design package, direct specialised skid-mounted engineering suppliers, build our campaign data backbone, upgrade our in-house pilot rigs, and ensure customer sampling campaigns achieve strict reproducibility. Your job is to challenge and translate our process design basis into safe, controlled, logged, and highly reproducible operation.

Tasks

Control Philosophy, P&IDs & Instrumentation:

  • Draft, review, and release complete P&IDs, control topologies, cause-and-effect interlock matrices, and alarm philosophies across our process options
  • Specify field instrumentation compatible with solvents, oxidants, and acidic media
  • Establish PLC/DCS control system architecture, hardware requirements, and communication protocols for skid-mounted modules

Process Safety, HAZOP & ATEX Compliance:

  • Be the internal owner for process safety, leading formal HAZOP, LOPA, and SIL assessment studies alongside external advisors and FEED suppliers
  • Establish ATEX zoning classifications, specify explosion-proof electrical and instrument equipment, and prepare technical safety dossiers for local German regulatory approvals in coordination with host sites and TÜV
  • Design safety instrumented systems and emergency shutdown logic for exothermic reactions, hydrogen peroxide dosing loops, and flammable vapour spaces

FEED Supplier Interface & Site Co-Location Safety:

  • Co-author Level Nine's basic design package deliverables to set clear specifications for external partners
  • Lead safety, instrumentation, and control interactions with specialised engineering suppliers through conceptual design, basic design, detailed engineering, and construction
  • Oversee control cabinet assembly, shop testing, FAT, and SAT

In-House R&D & Campaign Data/Control:

  • Design and maintain our campaign data infrastructure, including batch records, historian/DAQ structure, alarm/event logs, sample timestamps, control recipes, and partner campaign data packages. This backbone is what links laboratory/pilot experiments to reproducible results, FEED evidence, and GAP analysis
  • Implement practical data acquisition and modelling tools for kinetic, thermal, mass/energy, and solvent recycle models, using appropriate tools such as Python, Excel, Aspen, gPROMS, ChemCAD, or similar
  • Oversee control parameters during external partner campaigns, establishing standardised control protocols and logging systems to guarantee under 5% batch-to-batch variation

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on working experience drafting and verifying P&IDs, specifying instrumentation, and designing control philosophies, cause-and-effect matrices, and safety interlocks for chemical process plants
  • Demonstrated experience executing HAZOP/LOPA studies, ATEX zoning (Directives 2014/34/EU and 1999/92/EC), Seveso III compliance, and managing energetic or solvent reactions (peroxides, flammable solvents)
  • Proven track record generating basic design control documentation and managing modular skid fabricators (such as Zeton) through detail design, FAT, and SAT
  • Ability to collect data and model it using tools to draw FEED conclusions, establish dynamic models, and link experiments to reproducible results
  • Professional German proficiency (C1+, strictly required to lead HAZOPs, liaise with German regulatory authorities like TÜV/Bezirksregierung, and negotiate with local EPCs and fabricators) and fluent English
  • High agency, first-principles thinking, and practical engineering judgment. You treat safety not as a bureaucratic exercise of filling out forms, but as an opportunity to build safe, elegant, and workable systems in a fast-paced startup. You are comfortable getting your hands dirty troubleshooting sensors, control valves, or wiring on pilot rigs

Pluses:

  • Experience building batch records, DAQ structures, or campaign data packages
  • Degree in a relevant engineering field with a process safety specialisation
  • Practical familiarity with Pressure Equipment Directive (PED 2014/68/EU) and SIL ratings (IEC 61508/61511)

Though we have a number of hard criteria above, our hiring ethos is focussed on attitude over aptitude. This is far from a desk-only job, and we seek an out-of-the-box thinker who brings an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude. If you believe that process safety and control engineering can unlock strategic value beyond compliance and paperwork, this role is a one of a kind opportunity to define the next generation of industrial manufacturing.

Ultimately we are looking for someone for this role who can match our ambition, resilience, and excellence. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion are what will stand out and set you apart. We strongly welcome diverse perspectives and people who have the courage and conviction to make real change.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your CV along with 3–5 sentences about yourself and why you're interested in working at Level Nine. Please don't send us a standard cover letter - instead, please send a brief answer to the following questions:

  1. What is a complex process safety, HAZOP, or control loop challenge you have tackled on a plant or pilot rig, and how did you balance rigorous safety compliance with practical operational reality?
  2. What is something you geek out about outside of work that makes you uniquely you?
  3. If you could learn any new skill (professional or otherwise), what would it be and why? Please be specific.

About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

The Live Network team owns real-time execution of Deliveroo's delivery network across all European markets (UK&I, France, Italy, Belgium), with supporting scope in the Middle East. data.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
data.description:
Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

 

About the Role

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.

 

As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.

 

Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

 
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

  • Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

  • Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years’ experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

  • Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

  • Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

  • Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

  • Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

  • Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

  • Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

 

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

  • Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

  • Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).

data.title: Forward Deployed Investor
data.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Role

9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

 

What You Will Do

  • Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

  • Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

  • Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

  • Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

  • Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

 

What You Bring

You are a subject matter expert with 3+ years of practitioner experience at an asset manager, credit fund, or insurer, with fluency across end-to-end investment workflows in your area, not just the data those workflows consume. Specifically, in one or more of the following:

  • Credit portfolio management and research. High yield, leveraged loan, or multi-strategy credit investing, covering screening, underwriting, credit committee process, and ongoing portfolio monitoring

  • Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

  • CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

  • Distressed and special situations. Stressed and distressed credit analysis, restructuring and process tracking, documentation and covenant analysis, or capital structure work

  • Buy-side transformation, data, or research technology functions. Investment data, quantitative or systematic credit research, chief data office, digital transformation, or AI strategy roles where you have led or contributed to AI and workflow transformation projects specifically in credit investing

Beyond your domain expertise, you are:

  • Demonstrably interested in technology applied to your domain. For example: participation in an internal AI, data, or research technology working group; external vendor champion or evaluation lead for domain tech. You may have already moved to a technology company focused on credit markets.

  • Familiar with and hands-on with modern domain tooling. Direct user experience of Rogo, Hebbia, AlphaSense, Octus, or comparable AI-native platforms in your workflow. You can speak from experience about what works, what doesn't, and why.

  • Comfortable operating inside confidential investment processes. You will sit close to live pipelines, positions, and internal research. You are disciplined about what does and does not travel between accounts, and clients trust you quickly because of it.

  • A strong communicator across styles and audiences. Extremely comfortable with the analysts who will be the day-to-day platform users. Highly credible with portfolio managers, heads of research, and CIOs. Strong writing and in-person skills. Able to flex style for technical and business audiences.

  • Highly collaborative across a broad internal network. The function operates in close partnership with GTM, Product, Engineering, and other 9fin teams. You are energised by cross-functional work, you bring people with you rather than working around them, and you know how to translate what you are learning in the field into inputs that other teams can act on.

  • Outcome-oriented. You measure success by whether clients are actually using the platform differently, not by how many meetings you held or decks you delivered.

 

Why Join 9fin

  • Category leadership. 9fin is the reference platform for debt capital markets data and AI. Buy-side clients use us because there is no comparable alternative.

  • A genuine domain-expert role. You bring credit investing expertise; we back you with the platform, the product team, and the mandate to make it real inside client organisations.

  • Direct influence on the product. Field intelligence from your deployments feeds the product roadmap. What you learn on the ground shapes what 9fin builds next.

  • Series C stage, growing fast. Small enough that your work is visible, large enough to have the platform and customer base ready for real deployment.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

data.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. data.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

In the last few months alone we launched Fireworks Training, partnered with Microsoft Azure Foundry, and published research straight from our production systems. A few examples of what that looks like in practice:

  • Frontier RL is cheaper than the mega-cluster narrative suggests: we ran cross-region rollouts using 98% sparse weight deltas and published what we learned. (blog)

  • Open source agents with frontier advisors: matching frontier performance through training and harness engineering. (blog)

  • The fine-tuning bottleneck is not the algorithm: integration friction and iteration speed are what actually stall teams; we documented the patterns across dozens of customer engagements. (blog)

The Role

AI Field Engineers at Fireworks are the technical tip of the spear. You embed with our most ambitious customers and technology partners to turn complex AI problems into production systems, fast. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. You are hands-on-keyboard building POCs, MVPs, and production integrations, while also holding your own in executive-level conversations about architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

You spend most of your time building. You ship code, run benchmarks, debug production issues, and architect deployments. But you also lead discovery conversations, align stakeholders, and translate customer pain points into product improvements that compress the feedback loop from field to roadmap. This is a role for engineers who are comfortable on-site with customers, building the relationships and trust that happen in person, not just over a call.

The Segment

As a Field Engineer in the Enterprise track you will work with large organizations and digital-native companies adopting GenAI across the business. These engagements span more stakeholders and longer cycles, so you will manage executive relationships and align teams while staying hands-on in the code. The emphasis is on pairing strong technical delivery with the executive presence to earn trust across an org: discovery, solution design, POC execution, and the path to production at enterprise scale.

Technical Delivery and Deployment

  • Build end-to-end POCs and MVPs alongside customer engineering teams, working inside their codebases, infrastructure, and constraints.

  • For customers whose core product is built on GenAI, architect the inference foundations that capability depends on, and size deployments so they can scale in their market without infrastructure becoming the bottleneck.

  • Run load tests and establish latency, throughput, and cost baselines against realistic customer traffic profiles, and tune deployments to hit those targets

  • Deploy and validate new model families on inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang), determining optimal shapes, quantization configs, and serving patterns across workloads.

Model Strategy and Fine-Tuning

  • Guide customers on model selection, fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT), and evaluation methodology.

  • Build and run fine-tuning pipelines directly with customers, navigating trade-offs between model families, compute cost, and quality targets.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks that measure production-quality metrics, not just benchmark scores.

Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management

  • Many of our customers exist because of GenAI. Help them bake frontier model capabilities into their core offering and turn that into a durable competitive edge.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to unpack customer pain points, constraints, and success criteria before proposing solutions.

  • Spend time on-site with customers. Build trust and momentum in person, embedding with their teams where the work happens.

Product Feedback and Platform Improvement

  • Identify recurring customer pain points and translate them into concrete product proposals, working directly with engineering and product to ship fixes and features.

  • Codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute them back to internal tooling, documentation, and the platform itself.

  • Feed customer signals (deployment patterns, failure modes, feature gaps) back into the product roadmap with specificity and urgency.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, ML Engineer with field exposure, or technical founder.

  • Demonstrated ability to build production software with customers, not just advise on it. You have shipped code running in someone else's production environment.

  • Strong Python skills. Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging production code. Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure engineering.

  • Working knowledge of the LLM stack: inference trade-offs, model serving, fine-tuning workflows (SFT at minimum; DPO/RFT a strong plus).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying models on GPU infrastructure.

  • Exceptional communication: able to run a sharp discovery call, present to a VP, and debug a latency issue with an ML engineer in the same afternoon.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with inference serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and tuning deployments for real workloads.

  • Experience building or integrating agentic systems, tool-use chains, or AI-native developer toolchains.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Manager, you will lead Legora's compensation architecture and equity programs — the two pillars that most directly shape how we attract and retain exceptional talent at every level of the company.

Reporting into the VP of Total Rewards, you'll be the lead on compensation banding, equity administration, and the frameworks that ensure every compensation decision is principled, competitive, and fair. This is a builder's role: you'll be translating our reward strategy into systems that scale with us as we continue to grow across markets.

What you will do

  • Define and maintain compensation bands across Legora's job architecture, ensuring levels are consistently applied and market-aligned across functions and geographies.

  • Lead the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end: benchmarking, calibration, offer modelling, and manager communication.

  • Be Legora's people-side expert on equity — deeply understanding our equity programs, employee participation, vesting cycles, and how equity connects to performance and total reward.

  • Implement and evolve our compensation frameworks and total reward practices in line with the global strategy, ensuring they remain competitive, equitable, and transparent.

  • Conduct ongoing market benchmarking across all markets, using data to ensure Legora stays ahead of the curve.

  • Partner with Finance on compensation planning, equity modelling, and reward analytics.

  • Collaborate with Legal to ensure compliance in compensation and equity practices across all jurisdictions.

  • Build clear toolkits, templates, and policies that make reward decisions scalable and consistent across the organization.

  • Educate and enable managers and employees to understand, articulate, and trust our reward philosophy.

Who you are

You think in systems. You love the intersection of data, structure, and people — and you get energised by building things that make complex decisions feel simple and fair.

We think you'll thrive here if you have:

  • 7+ years in compensation, total rewards — ideally in a high-growth tech or scale-up environment.

  • Strong expertise in compensation banding and benchmarking.

  • Solid understanding of equity programs: plan structures, grant cycles, vesting, and how equity fits into the broader total reward picture.

  • Strong analytical skills — you're comfortable turning data into insights and insights into decisions.

  • A track record of partnering effectively with Finance and Legal.

Why Legora

This is a rare opportunity to shape the reward architecture of a company with serious global momentum. You'll have real influence over how we build fairly and competitively — and your work will be felt by every employee at Legora.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud — protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well — code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis — so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers.

  • End-to-end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration.

Success Metrics / KPIs: (drafted for hiring manager review and adjustment)

  • Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs.

  • Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates.

  • Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths.

  • Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates.

  • Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap.

  • Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start.

  • Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments.

  • Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to identify and resolve defects quickly.

  • Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgement on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships.

  • Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules.

  • Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python.

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS.

  • Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgement about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently.

  • Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience building large-scale web applications and REST APIs.

  • Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies.

  • Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform.

  • Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation.

  • Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test-driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code.

  • Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety.

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. data.description:
Project Delivery Technician (Hardware)

Contract: Full-Time, Permanent
Working Location: Basingstoke Head Office
Working Pattern: On-site 5 Days/Week

Overview:

Every Hawk-Eye system that goes live in a stadium starts life on a bench in Basingstoke. Getting it right there is what makes it work out there, in front of a crowd, first time, with no chance to stop and fix it.

As a Project Delivery Technician (Hardware), you'll build that kit. You'll assemble and configure hardware from individual components up to complete subsystems, test every build against spec, and make sure what leaves the building is ready to deploy. You'll work closely with our Hardware Project Managers to hit build schedules, keep stock and project bays in order, and diagnose problems as they come up. It's hands-on, practical work on the technology behind some of the biggest moments in sport.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Hardware Assembly: Assemble computer systems, servers, or other hardware components based on project specifications and technical documentation. Install and secure components such as processors, memory, storage devices, motherboards, power supplies, and peripheral devices into larger sub systems.

  • Configuration and Integration: Configure hardware components including specific operational settings, and operating systems. Integrate hardware components with software applications and ensure compatibility and proper functionality.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of hardware configurations, specifications, and build and testing checklists.

  • Logistics and Inventory Management: Manage and liaise hardware inventory with the stock controller and warehousing teams ensuring all project bays and shelving are fit for project builds and inventory is clearly accessible.

  • Coordinate: Collaborate with Project Managers (Hardware) to make sure you are aware of the build schedules and program to ensure all builds are completed on time for logistics and operational delivery. Highlight any issues that occur which could impact the timeline to key stakeholders including Hardware Project Managers and the Project Delivery Manager

  • Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues that occur during builds. Coordinate any learnings or feedback to the Hardware Support Manager as documentation may be required an update or a full-cycle refinement within Project Design.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest hardware and technology trends to provide innovative solutions to clients.

  • Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and best practices during hardware assembly and installation. Maintain a safe and clean working environment.


Requirements:

  • The role requires an eagerness to learn new skills and gain new knowledge to cover the continuously evolving hardware technologies used by all departments

  • Must possess good communication and organisational skills

  • Must demonstrate the ability to multitask, think analytically and problem solve

  • Must demonstrate a diligent & organised approach to resolving technical issues and supplying clear solutions, including replacement equipment, within the timescales available

  • Must take responsibility for their own work, standards and training program

  • Must be competent in the use of all tooling and take responsibility for the H&S of themselves and those around them

  • Must be flexible in order to facilitate up to 7 days on-site per year to ensure that the Operational Team adheres to hardware processes and procedures and suggests improvements where possible. This may include operational support under rare, business-critical circumstances

Equal Opportunity Employer

We ensure all employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion, age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - (HawkAI)
data.description:
Join Our Team as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (HawkAI) at Hawk-Eye Innovations

Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Office: Budapest, Váci út 144-150, 1138 Hungary

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our HawkAI team builds the foundational machine learning infrastructure that powers the future of sports intelligence. This is a build-from-zero role designed to bridge the gap between machine learning engineering and real-world application. You will be responsible for building the first-pass applications and services that sit on top of the HawkAI Engine, translating cutting-edge ML models and data pipelines into working, demonstrable software. If you thrive on autonomy, rapid execution, and leveraging modern AI-assisted workflows to build products from scratch, this is where you belong.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer who can comfortably navigate the entire stack to get credible first versions into the hands of users. You won't be handed a fully scoped brief; instead, you’ll work closely with ML engineers to figure out what a credible first pass looks like, making high-leverage architectural choices and proving out new product opportunities.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build-from-Zero Applications: Move across the entire stack to design, build, and deploy the first working software applications and services powered by the HawkAI Engine.

  • Bridge ML and Product: Translate complex ML models and real-time data pipelines into responsive, high-throughput APIs and intuitive user interfaces.

  • AI-Accelerated Development: Maximize your build velocity by deeply integrating modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools into your day-to-day workflow, while retaining strict human oversight on software architecture and data integrity.

  • Real-Time Visualization: Design and implement high-performance interfaces to stream and visualize 2D sports data with minimal latency.

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of early-stage applications, from cloud infrastructure (AWS) and CI/CD deployment to frontline delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • Versatile Full-Stack Expertise: Broad hands-on experience moving fluidly across backend, frontend, and deployment, specifically with Java, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, and modern responsive web technologies (HTML5/CSS3).

  • AWS & Infrastructure: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end cloud solutions on AWS infrastructure.

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Proven capability deploying production-ready CI/CD pipelines using Docker and GitHub Actions.

  • Data Streaming & 2D Rendering: Experience streaming, processing, and visualizing dynamic data using 2D rendering engine tools.

  • ML Integration: Experience building APIs and microservices that integrate directly with ML models, keeping latency and throughput constraints front-of-mind.

  • Pragmatic Quality: The ability to write high-quality, testable, and maintainable code that accounts for edge cases, even when executing at high speeds.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with 2D rendering libraries like PixiJS or mobile frameworks like React Native.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, SQL, Redis/Valkey, or infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

  • Familiarity with building or working alongside agentic AI systems.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not an ML Engineering Role: You will work directly with ML engineers, but your focus is building product services on top of their models.

  • Not a Fixed Roadmap Role: You won't execute against rigid specs; a key part of your initial phase is defining what the product should actually be.

  • Not a Management Role: This is a dedicated, high-impact individual contributor position.

  • Not a Long-Term Maintenance Role: You focus on turning 0 to 1; once opportunities are proven, dedicated teams scale and maintain them.

Hungary Benefits

  • Annual Leave: Standard according to local labour law.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model (2 days in our Budapest office per week).

  • Access to Sporting Events: Priority access and tickets to major sporting events.

  • Sony Group Discounts: Generous discounts across Sony Group products and services.

  • Other Benefits: Flexible Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, Nursery & Kindergarten contributions, Annual MOL Bubi Pass), Private Medical Insurance, Life & Accident Insurance, MindentMent Dental Clinic discounts, Seniority Awards, and an Employee Assistance Program.

data.title: Head of New Business (m/f/d) - EMEA
data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of New Business — EMEA to lead and transform our regional new business function. This is a building role. You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and own the EMEA new business strategy, tactical plan, team, and execution of how Statista wins net-new logos across mid-market and enterprise accounts. You will work within Statista’s global commercial strategy while using regional insight to influence the evolution of our global playbooks and policies.

You will inherit a small, capable, and ambitious team — and the mandate to build it into the engine that powers our 2027 growth. You will shape and embed the EMEA playbook, raise the bar, and build a high-performance culture, working in close alignment with our global commercial framework.

What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Installed a consistent EMEA new-business operating cadence covering pipeline creation, qualification, deal inspection, and forecasting.

  • Built a repeatable mid-market and enterprise acquisition playbook across inbound, outbound, and account-based motions.

  • Raised sales capability through structured coaching and practical adoption of MEDDICC or an equivalent enterprise methodology.

  • Improved pipeline quality, forecast confidence, and economic-buyer engagement across the team.

  • Defined the team structure and hiring plan required to support Statista’s 2027 growth ambitions.

What You Will Own

  • Hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing new business organisation, including Account Executives and close partnership with SDR leadership.

  • Building and embedding the operating cadence — pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecast governance — that turns activity into outcomes.

  • Designing and implementing MEDDICC as an operational sales methodology, not a CRM form-fill, and holding the team to that standard.

  • Partnering with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and the Statista Connect team to ensure inbound, outbound, account-based, and partnership motions operate as one commercial system.

  • Growing ARR through net-new acquisition and lifting average contract value through deliberate movement from user-level relationships to economic-buyer engagement.

  • Representing EMEA New Business in our global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional insight, evidence, and recommendations to help shape global strategy, standards, and playbooks.

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • Significant experience leading B2B new-business teams, with evidence that you have built or materially improved a commercial function and delivered measurable growth.

  • Demonstrable track record of selling across both mid-market and enterprise contexts — comfortable with sub-€100k ACV velocity sales and €100k+ ACV multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles.

  • Proven ability to grow ARR and ACV in a comparable B2B SaaS, data, or intelligence platform environment.

  • Practical fluency in MEDDICC, MEDDPICC, or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with evidence that you have embedded the approach into coaching, deal inspection, and forecast governance.

Capability

You can demonstrate that you have:

  • Built a repeatable pipeline-generation motion across inbound, outbound, and account-based channels.

  • Increased ACV or enterprise mix while protecting sales-cycle discipline.

  • Improved forecast accuracy and pipeline quality through a structured management cadence.

  • Developed managers and reps through live deal coaching and consistent inspection.

  • Built or materially upgraded a sales motion in an environment where the playbook, operating cadence, and cross-functional model were still evolving.

Leadership

  • A hands-on leader — you sit in deal reviews, join customer calls, and coach in the moment.

  • You build cultures where reps learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

  • You influence beyond your direct authority — across Marketing, Product, RevOps, and Hamburg HQ — to shape outcomes that need cross-functional alignment.

Desirable

  • Experience in data, intelligence, research, or information services.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and sales enablement tooling.

  • Experience working across multiple European markets.

Why Join Statista

  • A direct line to the VP Sales EMEA — fast decisions, clear accountability.

  • Real ownership of EMEA new business strategy and tactical execution, within Statista’s global commercial framework.

  • Visibility across global sales leadership and access to Hamburg HQ.

  • The chance to define what ‘good’ looks like for an EMEA function still being built.

  • A product story — Connect, Statista+, AI-ready data infrastructure — that is only getting stronger.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

  • Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

  • In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

  • 90-day strategic plan presentation.

  • Final conversation with the CCO.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices
